data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to share content via email, phone, WhatsApp, browser and system share UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple methods to open the system share sheet, launch email, phone dialer, WhatsApp chat and browser URLs. Uses url_launcher and open_filex under the hood for platform-specific handling.
use_when: Need to let users share a link or text via native share dialog
Want to open email, phone or WhatsApp from the app
avoid_when: Require advanced sharing features like multiple file attachments or custom share sheets
Need fine‑grained control over share intents beyond basic URLs
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, Linux
weaknesses: Relies on other packages for file handling
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, ensure Android manifest and iOS Info.plist have required permissions for intents and URL schemes if needed

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more feature‑rich share sheet with file support and broader community adoption

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can launch URLs, mailto, tel and WhatsApp directly without an extra wrapper
